etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Eva belongs to the international family of names associated with biblical Eve. The University of Copenhagen's name dictionary traces this family to Hebrew Havvah and its traditional association with giving life. This history concerns the name, rather than establishing a Malay common noun or identifying what the isolated input originally referred to. [Source](https://ordnet.dk/dnl/ordbog/Eve)
